title: Rollback advisor: dry-run shadow rehearsals + telemetry hooks
author: Elena Mendez
description:
Context and goal: Customers have asked for safer, explainable rollbacks that can be validated before an actual traffic swap. This PR introduces a Rollback Advisor runtime component and a dry-run "shadow rehearsal" flow that lets operators execute a rollout plan against mirrored (non-impacting) traffic, collect full telemetry, and get an automated rollback recommendation before committing a promote.

What this implements: (single-string sectioned description)
- Rollback Advisor service: an orchestration stage that consumes live telemetry from rehearsals and runs a decision function (heuristic + configurable thresholds) to compute a rollback score and suggested action (commit/promote/abort/auto-backout).
- Dry-run shadow rehearsals: traffic mirroring pipeline extension that marks rehearsals as non-committing, captures request/response pairs, and pipes them through a light-weight playback that exercises model variants without affecting upstream routing.
- Telemetry hooks: added structured traces and timeline events for rehearsal lifecycle, per-cohort latency/cost/quality signals, and a new rehearsal_metrics table for post-run analysis.
- A/B + canary compatibility: the advisor understands multi-variant schedules (A/B arms, percentage ramps, session-stickiness) and computes per-variant risk profiles.
- Operator feedback loop: an API endpoint and console integration that surfaces a proposed rollback playbook (exact steps + CI links + recommended wait windows) and a human-in-the-loop approve button.

Design notes and constraints:
- Decision function is pluggable: default uses thresholded SLO deltas (latency p95, 99th, token-level error rate, model perplexity proxy). We expose a simple policy-as-config JSON so customers can tune sensitivity.
- Rehearsal isolation: rehearsals run in isolated worker lanes and will never write to downstream systems (no DB writes / no external side effects) — enforced by a runtime tag and environment validators.
- Data retention: rehearsal payloads and telemetry are retained for 7 days by default; operators can extend retention via Console.
- Performance: rehearsal path is optimized for sampling and KV cache warmup; we added sampling policies to avoid undue load on serving pools.

Migration and rollout plan:
- This is behind feature-flag rollouts.config.rollout_rehearsal_v1 (default off).
- Step 1 (canary): enable on internal staging clusters, run three rehearsal jobs against latest models and verify telemetry collection.
- Step 2 (beta): enable for a small set of enterprise customers who opt in.
- Step 3 (GA): enable and document playbook in runbooks/ with recommended thresholds.

Testing and validation:
- Unit tests for advisor logic and policy evaluation (pkg/advisor/*)
- Integration tests that simulate A/B and canary schedules and verify recommended actions (integration/rollouts/rehearsal_test.go)
- Load test harness extension to ensure rehearsal sampling does not exceed configured pool budgets (benchmark-lab/rehearsal-budget)

release_notes: Introduces Rollback Advisor and dry-run shadow rehearsals. Operators can perform non-impacting rehearsals, inspect telemetry, and get an automated rollback recommendation prior to promote. Feature gated behind rollouts.config.rollout_rehearsal_v1.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag default is OFF. To enable rehearsals in staging: set rollouts.config.rollout_rehearsal_v1=true and ensure rehearsal worker pools are labeled 'rehearsal'. Watch rehearsal_metrics.* and timeline events. Do not enable in GA until policy tuning is completed.
